lines: Archify turns any messy code or plan into a beautiful interactive diagram you can explore.
Archify turns any idea or code into an interactive diagram for Claude Code and Codex.
Agents generate a typed source, validators check it for errors, and only correct diagrams get delivered.
Use Archify to diagram a web request where Browser calls API, cache misses Redis then PostgreSQL.
The Proof Lab contains all 11 checked-in scenarios, their JSON sources, and validation receipts.
It ranks #1 on GitHub Trending's weekly list for all languages.
The output is a self-contained HTML file that you can download and explore offline.
Install via npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g or use the Kimi Work plugin.
Archify is MIT licensed and used by Cursor, Codex, and Kimi Work.
Run this command to add Archify, then describe your idea in chat.
Save this for when you need to share a clear diagram from any codebase.
When you save this, your entire codebase becomes an instantly explorable archive.
